newsitem.title: INDIA: India castorseed prices fall on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: India castorseed prices fall on speculative buying.

text.p: Indian castorseed September delivery prices on Friday fell to 1,124/1,125 rupees per quintal from 1,131/1,132 rupees on the back of fresh speculative selling, dealers said.
Reports of widespread rain in producing centres prompted fresh bull liquidation as timely rain brightened prospects for the new crop.
"Absence of fresh overseas enquiries also subdued the market sentiments," one operator said.
Groundnut eased by 2/3 rupees at 352/353 rupees per 10 kg amid sluggish physical demand but inflows were low at 40/50 tonnes in the Bombay market due to heavy rain in producing areas.
In Rajkot, spot groundnut oil was steady at 550/555 rupees per 15 kg.
